business-overview.text: “Harmony’s story is one of continuing to strengthen our business for the long term: anchored by a strong gold foundation and complemented by growing copper exposure to create greater resilience and durability. FY26 marked an important step in that journey, with CSA joining our portfolio and Eva Copper under construction. Together with our stakeholders, we have come this far, and together we will continue to create enduring value for the future,” says Beyers Nel, Harmony’s CEO.
